headline: KING ROUTS RIGGS IN ASTRODOME TENNIS MATCH
dispatch: Billie Jean King defeated Bobby Riggs in straight sets, 6-4, 6-3, 6-3, before a packed Houston Astrodome and an international television audience. The widely billed Battle of the Sexes ended with King controlling the court against the 55-year-old former champion.
answer: Billie Jean King beats Bobby Riggs, 1973
